cases.locator: Opening;What Does a Small Candle Flame Mean Spiritually?;Read the Whole Candle,Not Only the Flame Height
cases.statement: The public practitioner account associates a persistently low flame in a reportedly sound candle with weak momentum or divided intention;this is not an assessment of the observer.

cases.locator: Opening;What Does Black Soot at the Top Mean Spiritually?;Top Soot Versus Bottom Soot
cases.statement: The public practitioner account associates upper black soot with clear glass below,after practical qualifications,with an initial obstacle that may be overcome.

cases.locator: How to Read the Density and Depth:Dense Black Band at the Rim
cases.statement: Within that upper-clearing context,the public account describes a dense black band as a stronger initial obstacle that may still be overcome.

cases.locator: How to Read the Density and Depth:Light Grey Haze
cases.statement: The public account associates a light grey haze allowing light through with smaller,manageable obstacles;this profile limits that comparison to upper deposits with clear lower glass.

cases.locator: How to Read the Density and Depth:Black From Top to Bottom;Does Black Soot at the Top Mean the Spell Failed?
cases.statement: The public account distinguishes dense black deposits throughout the jar from upper-only soot,and suggests reconsidering the objective;it does not establish spell failure or a hidden cause.

physical_policy.qualification: Known or possible unresolved explanation prevents application;not_noticed and unknown are insufficient. checked_no_issue requires an explicit completed correction or not_needed_after_check declaration. addressed requires reported_completed. Current adverse wick/draft/dressing/construction evidence contradicts a qualified summary.
physical_policy.followup: Tall requires completed correction and persisted follow-up. Low permits explicitly checked/no-issue/no-correction-needed OR completed correction with persisted follow-up. Improvement/changed means the selected abnormal height resolved in this schema;it is distinct from persistence.
physical_policy.no_proof: All checks,causes,corrections and follow-up remain user declarations. No cause noticed is never proof of physical absence or a spiritual cause.

safety_policy.locator: Tall:How Tall Should a Spell Candle Flame Be?;What Should You Do When the Flame Is Too Tall?;Soot:Should You Wipe the Soot Off?
safety_policy.policy: Any declared unsafe burning,overheating or active hazard in the session or an observation holds all symbolic display. Keep a stopped activity stopped;otherwise prioritize stopping safely. Do not manipulate hot equipment or maintain an unsafe burn for a reading. No real fire required.
safety_policy.unknown: Unknown safety is not a safety clearance;historical/hypothetical comparison does not authorize physical activity.

soot_policy: Upper black soot with clear lower glass remains distinct from dense full-jar black deposits. Dense-upper and light-grey/light-through upper cases have explicit refinements. Density is required only for rules depending on it;missing density never invents that refinement. Unknown substrate/location/extent remains unresolved. Opposed full-jar/clear-lower or upper-only/top-to-bottom declarations conflict.
no_physical_flame: Hypothetical,synthetic or previously reported observations suffice. No actual candle,water,video,sensor,hardware orphysical procedure required. The software creates no observation and verifies no cause.

documentary_lamp.account: Researcher describes a bilingual invocation/theophany account involving a lamp and release,with interpretive uncertainty. It is not a modern flame-sign dictionary.

evidence_matrix.direct: Precisely dated and located public practitioner accounts,not independently validated facts about the observer/future
evidence_matrix.editorial: Conservative condition andconflict bookkeeping,safety suppression,neutral synthesis/reflection
evidence_matrix.unsupported: Objective predictions,spirits,third-party feelings,diagnosis,personality/willpower assessment,hidden intentions or paranormal validation
